# OAuth 2.0 Token Endpoint Analysis

This is a Next.js API route implementing the OAuth 2.0 token exchange endpoint. Here's what it accomplishes:

## Core Functionality

The endpoint exchanges authorization codes for JWT access tokens via `POST /oauth/token`. It performs server-to-server communication using Supabase's admin client to bypass row-level security.

## Security Validations

The implementation includes multiple security checks:

- **Grant type validation**: Ensures the request uses `authorization_code` type
- **Client authentication**: Verifies client credentials against hashed secrets in the database
- **Authorization code validation**: Confirms the code belongs to the requesting client and matches the redirect URI
- **Expiration checking**: Rejects expired codes and removes them from the database
- **PKCE verification**: Validates the code verifier against the stored challenge using the specified method

## Response Format

Upon successful validation, the endpoint returns: `"access_token": [JWT], "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in": 3600, "scope": [requested scopes]`

The JWT payload includes user identifiers, display name, Discord ID, generation, status, and requested scope, bound to the specific client application.

## Post-Exchange Cleanup

The authorization code is deleted after successful exchange or when expired, preventing replay attacks.

---
title: "POST /oauth/token - Main Token Exchange Flow (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse: formData = request.formData()
    q_parse --> q_validate_grant: extract grant_type, code, redirect_uri, client_id, client_secret, code_verifier
    q_validate_grant --> q_err_grant: grantType != authorization_code
    q_validate_grant --> q_validate_params: grantType == authorization_code
    q_err_grant --> [*]: return 400 unsupported_grant_type
    q_validate_params --> q_err_params: !code || !redirectUri || !clientId || !clientSecret || !codeVerifier
    q_validate_params --> q_auth_client: all required params present
    q_err_params --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request
    q_auth_client --> q_verify_secret: application found
    q_auth_client --> q_err_client: appError || !application
    q_err_client --> [*]: return 401 invalid_client
    q_verify_secret --> q_get_code: isValidSecret == true
    q_verify_secret --> q_err_secret: isValidSecret == false
    q_err_secret --> [*]: return 401 invalid_client
    q_get_code --> q_validate_code: authCode found
    q_get_code --> q_err_code: codeError || !authCode
    q_err_code --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant
    q_validate_code --> q_check_expiry: authCode.application_id == application.id AND authCode.redirect_uri == redirectUri
    q_validate_code --> q_err_code_owner: authCode.application_id != application.id
    q_validate_code --> q_err_code_redirect: authCode.redirect_uri != redirectUri
    q_err_code_owner --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant code issued to different client
    q_err_code_redirect --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant redirect URI mismatch
    q_check_expiry --> q_pkce: expires_at >= now
    q_check_expiry --> q_delete_expired: expires_at < now
    q_delete_expired --> [*]: delete code, return 400 invalid_grant expired
    q_pkce --> q_get_user: PKCE valid
    q_pkce --> q_err_pkce: PKCE invalid
    q_err_pkce --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant PKCE verification failed
    q_get_user --> q_generate_token: member found
    q_get_user --> q_err_user: !member
    q_err_user --> [*]: return 500 server_error user not found
    q_generate_token --> q_cleanup: accessToken = generateAccessToken(payload, clientId)
    q_cleanup --> q_respond: delete_authorization_code(code)
    q_respond --> [*]: return 200 access_token, token_type, expires_in, scope

    note right of q_validate_grant
        INV-001: Only authorization_code grant type is accepted
        INV-002: All six parameters are mandatory - no partial requests allowed
    end note

    note right of q_auth_client
        INV-003: Client lookup uses RPC get_application_by_client_id bypassing RLS
        INV-004: Client secret is compared against stored hash via verifyClientSecret
    end note

    note right of q_validate_code
        INV-005: Authorization code must belong to the requesting client (application_id match)
        INV-006: redirect_uri must exactly match the value used during authorization
    end note

    note right of q_check_expiry
        INV-007: Expired codes are deleted before returning error (cleanup on reject)
    end note

    note right of q_pkce
        INV-008: PKCE code_verifier must match stored code_challenge using code_challenge_method
    end note

    note right of q_cleanup
        INV-009: Authorization code is single-use - deleted after successful exchange
        INV-010: JWT payload includes sub, display_name, discord_id, generation, status, scope
    end note

---
title: "Parameter Validation (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse_form: formData = request.formData()
    q_parse_form --> q_extract: extract all 6 fields from formData
    q_extract --> q_check_grant: grantType, code, redirectUri, clientId, clientSecret, codeVerifier assigned
    q_check_grant --> q_err_grant: grantType != authorization_code
    q_check_grant --> q_check_required: grantType == authorization_code
    q_err_grant --> [*]: return 400 unsupported_grant_type
    q_check_required --> q_err_missing: !code || !redirectUri || !clientId || !clientSecret || !codeVerifier
    q_check_required --> [*]: all params present - proceed to client auth
    q_err_missing --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request Missing required parameters

    note right of q_extract
        INV-001: All form fields are cast to string via "as string" - no type validation beyond presence
        INV-002: Empty string values would pass the truthy check only if non-null
    end note

    note right of q_check_grant
        INV-003: Only authorization_code grant type is supported - no implicit, client_credentials, or refresh_token
    end note

---
title: "Client Authentication (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_create_admin: supabase = createAdminClient()
    q_create_admin --> q_lookup: rpc get_application_by_client_id(clientId)
    q_lookup --> q_check_app: response received
    q_check_app --> q_err_not_found: appError || !application
    q_check_app --> q_verify_hash: application found
    q_err_not_found --> [*]: return 401 invalid_client
    q_verify_hash --> q_check_secret: isValidSecret = verifyClientSecret(clientSecret, application.client_secret_hash)
    q_check_secret --> q_err_bad_secret: isValidSecret == false
    q_check_secret --> [*]: isValidSecret == true - proceed to code validation
    q_err_bad_secret --> [*]: return 401 invalid_client Invalid client credentials

    note right of q_create_admin
        INV-001: Admin client bypasses RLS - this is server-to-server only, no cookie auth
    end note

    note right of q_lookup
        INV-002: Client lookup uses RPC function, not direct table query
        INV-003: Only first result (applications[0]) is used
    end note

    note right of q_verify_hash
        INV-004: Secret comparison is hash-based via verifyClientSecret, not plaintext
        INV-005: Same 401 error for both missing client and wrong secret (no enumeration)
    end note

---
title: "Authorization Code Validation (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_fetch_code: rpc get_authorization_code(code)
    q_fetch_code --> q_check_exists: response received
    q_check_exists --> q_err_invalid: codeError || !authCode
    q_check_exists --> q_check_owner: authCode found
    q_err_invalid --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant Invalid or expired authorization code
    q_check_owner --> q_err_wrong_client: authCode.application_id != application.id
    q_check_owner --> q_check_redirect: authCode.application_id == application.id
    q_err_wrong_client --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant Code was issued to different client
    q_check_redirect --> q_err_redirect: authCode.redirect_uri != redirectUri
    q_check_redirect --> q_check_expiry: authCode.redirect_uri == redirectUri
    q_err_redirect --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant Redirect URI mismatch
    q_check_expiry --> q_delete_expired: new Date(expires_at) < new Date()
    q_check_expiry --> [*]: expires_at >= now - proceed to PKCE
    q_delete_expired --> q_err_expired: rpc delete_authorization_code(code)
    q_err_expired --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant Authorization code expired

    note right of q_fetch_code
        INV-001: Code retrieval uses RPC function, not direct table query
        INV-002: Only first result (authCodes[0]) is used
    end note

    note right of q_check_owner
        INV-003: Code must be bound to the same application_id that authenticated
        INV-004: Redirect URI must exactly match the stored value (no partial matching)
    end note

    note right of q_delete_expired
        INV-005: Expired codes are proactively deleted from DB on detection
        INV-006: Expiry check uses server-side Date comparison (subject to clock skew)
    end note

---
title: "PKCE Verification (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_verify: isPKCEValid = verifyCodeChallenge(codeVerifier, authCode.code_challenge, authCode.code_challenge_method)
    q_verify --> q_check: evaluation complete
    q_check --> q_err_pkce: isPKCEValid == false
    q_check --> [*]: isPKCEValid == true - proceed to token issuance
    q_err_pkce --> [*]: return 400 invalid_grant PKCE verification failed

    note right of q_verify
        INV-001: PKCE uses stored code_challenge_method (S256 or plain) to verify
        INV-002: code_verifier is matched against code_challenge stored at authorization time
        INV-003: Prevents authorization code interception attacks (RFC 7636)
    end note

---
title: "Token Issuance and Cleanup (stem-system OAuth Token Endpoint)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_get_member: supabase.from(members).select(*).eq(supabase_auth_user_id, authCode.user_id).single()
    q_get_member --> q_check_member: query complete
    q_check_member --> q_err_user: !member
    q_check_member --> q_generate: member found
    q_err_user --> [*]: return 500 server_error User not found
    q_generate --> q_cleanup: accessToken = generateAccessToken(payload, clientId)
    q_cleanup --> q_respond: rpc delete_authorization_code(code)
    q_respond --> [*]: return 200 access_token + token_type Bearer + expires_in 3600 + scope

    note right of q_get_member
        INV-001: User lookup uses supabase_auth_user_id from the authorization code
        INV-002: Uses admin client so RLS is bypassed for member table access
    end note

    note right of q_generate
        INV-003: JWT payload contains sub, display_name, discord_id, generation, status, scope
        INV-004: Token is bound to clientId (audience)
        INV-005: Token expires in 3600 seconds (1 hour) - hardcoded
    end note

    note right of q_cleanup
        INV-006: Authorization code is deleted after successful token generation (single-use enforcement)
        INV-007: Code deletion happens AFTER token generation - if deletion fails, code could be replayed
    end note

---
title: "GET /oauth/userinfo (stem-system OAuth UserInfo)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_extract_header: authHeader = request.headers.get("Authorization")
    q_extract_header --> q_check_bearer: authHeader exists
    q_extract_header --> q_error_missing: authHeader missing or not starts with "Bearer "
    q_check_bearer --> q_extract_token: authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    q_check_bearer --> q_error_missing: not startsWith("Bearer ")
    q_error_missing --> [*]: return 401 createOAuthError("invalid_request")

    q_extract_token --> q_verify: token = authHeader.substring(7)
    q_verify --> q_check_payload: payload = verifyAccessToken(token)
    q_check_payload --> q_error_invalid: payload is null
    q_check_payload --> q_return_info: payload is valid
    q_error_invalid --> [*]: return 401 createOAuthError("invalid_token")

    q_return_info --> [*]: return 200 JSON(sub, display_name, discord_id, generation, status)

    note right of q_extract_header
        INV-001: Authorization header must be present and use Bearer scheme
        INV-002: Only Bearer token scheme is accepted; all other schemes are rejected
    end note

    note right of q_verify
        INV-003: verifyAccessToken must validate JWT signature and expiration
        INV-004: Null payload from verifyAccessToken means token is invalid or expired
    end note

    note right of q_return_info
        INV-005: Response must only contain claims from the verified JWT payload
        INV-006: No database lookup is performed; all user info comes from token claims
    end note
